evidence: Sharp bound exciton features were observed in low temperature (4.2 K) photoluminescence spectra obtained on GaAs films grown at 500 °C using trimethylgallium. The purity of the epitaxial layer was high and 77K mobility of 65 000 cm2 IV s ( n77 K = 1.6 X 1015 em') was attained for GaAs film using triethylgallium as gallium source.
